unblock_condition: Commit the shared package modules (frontends.py, gc_history.py, g2i_path35.py, explore.py) as used by the GA scoring path, or provide the per-pair parent forecast and the (x, d) feature arrays for the panel. The real ATLAS trajectories for the 8 reserved proteins are also needed unless the precomputed per-pair inputs are provided instead.
why_missing_blocks_scoring: components() (ga348) and inputs() (ga344) read the per-protein generated-ensemble npz files (pair/tracks) for both force fields. The GA348 parent per-pair forecast and the GA386 head features are both computed from these files. blind-ga351.npz stores only GA384's mixed prediction (0.8*parent + 0.2*head384), so the parent forecast cannot be recovered from committed outputs. The ensembles were never committed on any branch (git history checked: only blind-ga351.json and blind-ga351.npz exist for the blind panel).
why_not_regenerated: The ensembles are stochastic OpenMM simulations (ga351_generate.py; locked.json records proteins/origin/window/branches/step/minimize but no seeds). Regenerating them here would produce a different panel, the GA348 parent would not reproduce its recorded values (correlation 0.621945, RMSE 0.499672, residual SD 0.499486), and the run would no longer be the same scoring path as GA384's blind scoring. Per the assignment, failure of the parent reproduction means record and stop.
